## Verdict
accepted

## Concerns
- The result is correctly bounded: exact theorem text for DOI `10.1112/jlms.12832` was not retrieved, so applicability to the degree-\(d+4\), \(\min(i,j)=3\) target remains unresolved.
- The report explicitly states that the requested target was not established and does not substitute the broader minimality conjecture.
